design_notes.age: the engine's integer age(p) in the base season (rl_model.age: max(2026-by, 18+(2026-cycle_year))); the fit used Y - birth_year per (player, base season Y)
design_notes.application: RELATIVE, sum-preserving per integer age: vP_k' = round(vP_k * S_k / Sbar_k(age)), with Sbar_k(age) = sum(vP_k * S_k) / sum(vP_k) over ALL active rows at that age (value-weighted by the lens value itself; hazard_part2.py section [f])
design_notes.bands: career-games bands; the base (reference) band is 1-5 games; the four dummies are 6-20, 21-50, 51-100, 101+
design_notes.games: career games through the base season (the board row's g = p['games']); fit: cumulative games <= Y
design_notes.monotone_in_evidence: S(age,g) = min over band midpoints m in band_midpoints with m >= g of S_raw(age,m), together with S_raw(age,g); for g > 180, S_raw(age,g). (hazard_final_v2.py line 36)
design_notes.zero_games: a 0-game row takes the intake-cohort 'ever plays' rate ever0[type|tenure] as S2 and sqrt of it as S1 (UNMEASURED interpolation, hazard_final_v2.py lines 58-62); tenure = clamp(2026-year (+1 for MSD), 1, 2); unknown type -> ever0_default

fit.model: additive-logit (IRLS, ridge 1e-6) per lens: S1 = P(listed one season on), S2 = P(listed two seasons on)
fit.owner_stated_window: 2019-2025 (the owner's brief; the fitting script's loop is range(2010, 2025) — recorded as run)
fit.rows: every (player, base season Y) with cumulative games > 0, 2010 <= Y <= 2024, player listed in Y; outcome observed to 2026 (n = 9297)

ruling_text: D-H = H2: retirement/exit risk on the +1 and +2 lens values is probability-based survival, spread across each age cohort by risk, SUM-PRESERVING within each age band. Pure H2 (lifts allowed) is the default; cap_lift=true is the measurement variant that caps the multiplier at 1.0.
